wm size can only shrink the whole logical display, and the platform does not paint the freed area black. This app shrinks the display and draws an overlay over the freed strip, which is what makes the bottom safe area visible. Android cannot change resolution per app silently, so the display is shrunk only while a selected app is in front and restored as soon as an unselected one comes up.

Shizuku is not installed on this device, and the bottom safe area needs it to run system commands.

How Shizuku is used:
1. Install it, open it, and follow its own guide to pair over wireless debugging and start the service;
2. Come back here and tap Grant, then allow it in the Shizuku dialog;
3. This page unlocks automatically once the grant is in place.

For the exact pairing and start-up steps, follow the instructions inside the Shizuku app.
